categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the Private Broadcast label and modifies PeerManagerImpl in net_processing to handle private broadcast state.
categories.rationale: This change is an internal cleanup wrapping `PeerManagerImpl::m_tx_for_private_broadcast` in `std::optional` when `-privatebroadcast` is disabled. It offers negligible resource improvements because `std::optional` retains inline storage, and does not alter peer-to-peer behavior or fix an active bug.
